welcome.title: Welcome to Kettu
welcome.lead: A beautiful home for the coding agents you already use: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Pi, side by side.
welcome.fine: Free and open source. Your work stays on this computer.

choose.title: How will you use Kettu?
choose.lead: Everything on this computer works either way. You can change this later in Settings.

selfHosted.name: Local
selfHosted.note: Everything stays on your own network.

signIn.title: Sign in to Kettu
signIn.lead: Use email, GitHub, Google or Apple. It's free.
signIn.fine: Opens www.kettu.sh in your browser, then brings you back.
signIn.waitingHint: Finish signing in at www.kettu.sh, then come back.
signIn.doneLead: Kettu cloud is on for this computer. Pair your phone or open the web app whenever you like.

agents.title: Your agents are ready
agents.lead: Kettu found these on this computer and uses the sign-ins you already have in the terminal.
agents.note: Add or remove agents any time in Settings › Agents.
agents.noneLead: Install one here, or install it in your terminal and come back to re-detect.
agents.loading: Looking for agents on this computer…

stage.noModelsHint: It drives the coding agents you install, signed in with your own accounts.
stage.placeholder: Ask anything, or type / for commands
stage.thisComputerHint: This computer · your agents run here
stage.caption: Kettu passes your sessions along without being able to read them.

site.noPassword: No password. New here? This creates your free account.
site.confirmHint: Kettu on this computer will use your account for Kettu cloud.
site.never: Kettu never sees your password, and the browser never sees your sessions.
site.full: This account is signed in on all its devices
site.fullHint: Sign one out to sign in on {{computer}}, or move to Pro.
site.plans: Free and Pro differ only in devices and storage.
